Welcome to the channel that gives hope, help and healing to people over 50. I'm Will Harlow – a physiotherapist, clinic owner, and bestselling author on a mission to help 100 million over-fifties break free from pain, move with confidence, and stay independent for life.

Whether you're here to beat joint pain, improve your strength, or finally feel in control of your health again – you're in the right place. Through my videos, book, Lifelong Mobility program, or in-person treatment at my UK clinic, I've helped thousands of over-fifties to avoid painkillers and surgery – even when they've been told there's no other option.

You can explore ways to work with me or download your 100% free Stronger for Life Roadmap (an exercise plan tailored to your level of strength and mobility) below:
